name: ai-council
description: Get parallel code reviews from GPT-4, Grok, Claude, Gemini, and self-hosted Ollama - via API keys or your existing CLI subscriptions - with scoped review, debate, and consolidation.

commands.title: AI Council: Review Current File (Power Mode)

ai-council.pythonPath.description: Path to Python executable. Machine-scoped: a workspace's own .vscode/settings.json cannot override this, since it directly controls what executable this extension runs - see design-decisions.md for why.

ai-council.scriptPath.description: Path to ai_council.py script. Leave empty to use bundled script. Machine-scoped: a workspace's own .vscode/settings.json cannot override this, since it directly controls what code this extension runs - see design-decisions.md for why.

ai-council.apiKeys.openai.description: OpenAI API Key (for GPT-4). Get yours at: https://platform.openai.com/api-keys. Machine-scoped: a workspace's own .vscode/settings.json cannot read or redirect this - see design-decisions.md.

ai-council.apiKeys.anthropic.description: Anthropic API Key (for Claude). Get yours at: https://console.anthropic.com/. Machine-scoped: a workspace's own .vscode/settings.json cannot read or redirect this - see design-decisions.md.

ai-council.apiKeys.xai.description: xAI API Key (for Grok). Get yours at: https://console.x.ai/. Machine-scoped: a workspace's own .vscode/settings.json cannot read or redirect this - see design-decisions.md.

ai-council.apiKeys.google.description: Google API Key (for Gemini - FREE!). Get yours at: https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey. Machine-scoped: a workspace's own .vscode/settings.json cannot read or redirect this - see design-decisions.md.

ai-council.apiKeys.ollama.description: Auth for your Ollama/self-hosted endpoint, if it requires any (user:pass for Basic auth, or a Bearer token). Leave blank for an unauthenticated local Ollama server. Machine-scoped: a workspace's own .vscode/settings.json cannot read or redirect this - see design-decisions.md.

ai-council.models.openai.standard.description: Model ID the GPT-4/OpenAI API seat uses in standard mode. Any model ID your OpenAI account can access - not validated against a fixed list, since new models ship faster than this extension would be updated to list them.

ai-council.models.openai.power.description: Model ID the GPT-4/OpenAI API seat uses when Power Mode is on. Cost estimates in reports are a rough per-provider guess and do not automatically adjust to whatever model you set here.

ai-council.models.anthropic.standard.description: Model ID the Claude API seat uses in standard mode. Any model ID your Anthropic account can access - not validated against a fixed list.

ai-council.models.anthropic.power.description: Model ID the Claude API seat uses when Power Mode is on. Cost estimates in reports are a rough per-provider guess and do not automatically adjust to whatever model you set here.

ai-council.models.xai.standard.description: Model ID the Grok API seat uses in standard mode. Any model ID your xAI account can access - not validated against a fixed list.

ai-council.models.xai.power.description: Model ID the Grok API seat uses when Power Mode is on. Cost estimates in reports are a rough per-provider guess and do not automatically adjust to whatever model you set here.

ai-council.models.google.standard.description: Model ID the Gemini API seat uses in standard mode. Any model ID your Google account can access - not validated against a fixed list.

ai-council.models.google.power.description: Model ID the Gemini API seat uses when Power Mode is on. Cost estimates in reports are a rough per-provider guess and do not automatically adjust to whatever model you set here.

ai-council.ollamaUrl.description: Ollama / OpenAI-compatible self-hosted server URL. Machine-scoped: a workspace's own .vscode/settings.json cannot redirect this to an attacker-controlled endpoint - see design-decisions.md.

ai-council.ollamaModels.description: Comma-separated list of model names for your Ollama/self-hosted endpoint. Each model appears as a separate toggleable seat in the UI. Example: 'llama3.1:70b,qwen2.5:32b,mistral:7b'. Machine-scoped: a workspace's own .vscode/settings.json cannot force your already-machine-scoped Ollama server to run models you did not choose.

ai-council.autoReviewOnSave.description: Run a full review immediately whenever a supported source file is saved. Requires the AI Council sidebar (or any AI Council command) to have run at least once this window session - saves before that won't trigger a review, since the extension only activates on first use, not at VS Code startup. Machine-scoped: a workspace's own .vscode/settings.json cannot silently turn this on - see design-decisions.md.

ai-council.reviewRubric.description: What the council should look for during a review (layer 2). Leave blank for the built-in default (bugs, security, performance, code quality, architecture). This does NOT replace the permanent integrity rule (layer 1: no manufactured findings, no rubber-stamped consensus) - that always applies and cannot be edited here.
